About me

Capturing the Beauty of Nature in Dundee, Scotland

About Jo Smith

Nature Photographer based in Dundee, Scotland

My Journey

Photography has been my passion for over a decade. Growing up in the stunning landscapes of Scotland, I developed a deep appreciation for the natural world and its ever-changing beauty. What started as a hobby with a basic camera has evolved into a lifelong dedication to capturing the essence of nature.

My work focuses on the raw beauty of Scotland's landscapes, wildlife, and coastal scenes. I believe that every moment in nature tells a story, and my goal is to preserve those fleeting moments of wonder and share them with the world.

My Approach

I specialize in outdoor and nature photography, with a particular focus on the Scottish Highlands, coastal landscapes, and wildlife. Each photograph is carefully composed to showcase the unique character and atmosphere of the location.

Whether it's the golden light of dawn breaking over a misty glen, the dramatic cliffs of the Scottish coast, or the gentle presence of Highland cattle in their natural habitat, I strive to create images that evoke emotion and connection to the natural world.

Services

I offer a range of photography services including landscape photography, wildlife photography, and commissioned work for conservation projects and tourism businesses. My prints are available for purchase and make beautiful additions to any home or office.

I'm also available for photography workshops and guided photo walks around Dundee and the Scottish Highlands, where I share my knowledge and techniques with fellow photography enthusiasts.
